Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly labeled the 1984 event in Kathmandu as the “1984 Asian Games (the 1st SAF Games),” conflating the South Asian Games (SAF Games) with the Asian Games. These are distinct competitions; Kathmandu hosted the 1st South Asian Games in 1984, not the Asian Games.
